main_text.l: μῶμα, exponit Hesychius, συνελκόμενα ἡ ἀπαλωδῶς
συμπαθῶς ἐγλίζουσα. Eadem verba habet Etymologici Magni
auctor, nisi quòd correctiùs ille ἀπαλωδῶς, pro ἀπαλωδῶς;
& συνελίζουσα, pro ἐγγίζουσα. pro συνελίζουσα autem a-
sive γεμπόμενα, hoc sensu quem indicare
voluit hîc Hesychius, quàm quod An-
gli vulgò, gripings, de stomachi, vel
quæ sacra apud Indos primùm instituta

page.notes: Greek text is partly damaged and set in a fragmentary type; the Greek transcriptions are best-effort. "gripings" is printed in bold. Handwritten marginal number "112" at top right is not printed text and is omitted.
